# geo-spatial.types: GeoPolygon

**Status:** Experimental (tier `future`). Aspirational vocabulary. It must parse and type-check; it is not linted or converted to C#.

## Summary

> A polygonal region on the planet's surface: an outer boundary ring plus
> zero or more hole rings. Rings are implicitly closed (last coordinate joins
> the first); the boundary winds counter-clockwise seen from above, holes
> clockwise.

    implements IGeoRegion
